items.title: Tucker Carlson claims Trump is days from a nuclear strike on Iran
items.summary: Tucker Carlson posted that, under pressure from Netanyahu, the administration "may be within days" of a nuclear strike on Iran. It topped X's trends, but nothing backed it up: the White House dismissed it and Trump said no.
items.author: @TuckerCarlson

post.name: Tucker Carlson
